paths.description: Homepage and latest-story listing; represents discovery, navigation, theme, performance, privacy and responsive layout.
Library search/filter listing; represents browse and filtering.
Story detail page; represents article metadata, reading and chapter navigation.
Discussion listing; represents community content and long-form mixed-language text.
Login form; represents authentication, labels, autofill and invalid-input recovery.
Deliberately invalid route; represents HTTP failure recovery.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: The homepage CSS/DOM probe found no view-transition usage, while the primary browse journey crosses homepage, library and story routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages do not provide scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout measured a 4,741px homepage, but the DOM/CSS probe found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll progress affordance on long listing and story pages.

findings.summary: Repeated card components rely on viewport layout rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The same story-card pattern appears across homepage and library, but the CSS probe found no @container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list regions a containment context and adapt card internals with size container queries.

findings.summary: The not-found state is a dead end.
findings.evidence: The exercised invalid route renders only “Not Found” and a sentence, with no site navigation, search, home link or suggested recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the normal shell on 404 pages and offer Home, Library and search recovery actions.

findings.summary: Image delivery and cache lifetimes waste most of the page transfer.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 592,613 transferred bytes, including 489,530 image bytes; Lighthouse estimates 444 KiB cache and 349 KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Resize and encode covers responsively, lazy-load below-fold covers, and set durable immutable caching for fingerprinted/static assets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and unminified CSS/JS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports about 11 KiB unused CSS plus roughly 2 KiB each of unminified CSS and JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Purge unused selectors and minify production CSS/JS; load page-specific code only where needed.

findings.summary: Repeated like controls and an advertising frame have broken accessible naming.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found every visible like count excluded from its aria-label, and a footer ad iframe without a title; the image probe also found one tracking image without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Include visible count text in each accessible name, title the iframe (or make it presentational), and give decorative pixels empty alt.

findings.summary: Primary blue controls do not meet text contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.71:1 for white text on #4f7cff on Search, Browse Stories, pagination and Go controls, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the blue control surface or use a darker foreground so normal-size text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every theme.

findings.summary: The homepage skips its top-level heading.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no h1 on the homepage; its hierarchy begins at H2 Latest Stories, although the story and login templates do have H1s.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise page-specific H1 and retain the existing logical H2/H3 sequence.

findings.summary: A missing favicon produces a console/network error on every load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and HAR both record a 404 for https://kkstories.com/favicon.ico.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish the referenced favicon or remove/fix the stale reference.

findings.summary: Cover images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image probe found 6 of 7 images without width/height, lazy loading or srcset; all six covers were oversized JPEGs.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height, srcset/sizes, loading=lazy below the fold, and AVIF/WebP alternatives.

findings.summary: Story canonicals use a different host form from the delivered URL.
findings.evidence: The story loaded at non-www kkstories.com but declares https://www.kkstories.com/... as canonical, adding an avoidable host redirect/duplicate signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Standardise redirects, sitemap URLs, Open Graph URLs and canonical links on one host form.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks Organization/WebSite structured data.
findings.evidence: The homepage has Open Graph metadata but zero JSON-LD blocks; the story template correctly includes Book and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/Organization JSON-LD on the homepage, including the canonical URL and search action where appropriate.

findings.summary: The main document has no Content-Security-Policy and sets SameSite=None popunder cookies.
findings.evidence: Header evidence shows HTTPS, HSTS and other defenses but no CSP; cookie evidence found ts_popunder cookies with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, minimise third-party script origins, and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site cookie delivery is essential.

findings.summary: The homepage makes a disproportionate advertising/tracking footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 9 third-party origins; HAR counted 11 third-party requests and 72,354 transferred bytes, while Lighthouse observed four third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove popunder/tracking vendors where possible, load ads only after informed choice, partition necessary state, and audit every retained third party.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only.
findings.evidence: The login probe found correct username/current-password autofill and recovery, but no WebAuthn/PublicKeyCredential flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside the existing password fallback.

findings.summary: HTTP failure handling falls outside the usable site experience.
findings.evidence: The real 404 response lacks viewport metadata, styling, navigation and retry/search options.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a responsive branded 404 template with clear recovery links and preserve the requested context where possible.

findings.summary: Malayalam pages are declared as English and styles are not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The homepage and Malayalam story both declare html lang="en" while Open Graph says ml_IN and most visible text is Malayalam; the CSS probe found no logical-property usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare lang="ml" on Malayalam-first pages (or mark language runs precisely) and migrate directional spacing to logical properties.

findings.summary: The global search field uses an invalid autocomplete token.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags autocomplete="search" as invalid; login fields correctly use username and current-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the invalid token from search or use autocomplete="off" where justified; retain valid login tokens.

findings.summary: Below-fold covers are oversized legacy JPEGs.
findings.evidence: Six covers display at 124px but have natural widths around 454–472px, have no responsive sources, and account for most of the 489,530 image bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP variants and let srcset/sizes select the smallest adequate image.

findings.summary: Advertising code performs avoidable background network work.
findings.evidence: The page contacts 9 third-party origins, including multiple tsyndicate scripts, pixel syncs and analytics requests before any ad interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer nonessential vendor code until consent/visibility, batch analytics, and remove duplicate pixel syncs.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and pixels consume a large share of a simple text listing.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 72,354 bytes and 11 requests to third parties; the ad SDK is also the largest script group.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party byte/request budget, lazy-load below-fold ads and cache or self-host permitted static dependencies.
